verdict.rationale: Committing and pushing is a fair question for a GitHub mobile client, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents reviewing, merging, triaging and delegating changes to Copilot agents, not the developer authoring commits and pushing them from the device. A hands-on community comment also notes it 'doesn't really seem to be a git client.' Agent-made pull requests and PR merges are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can commit and push changes directly from my device
